description: Integrity. Resilience. Strength. Compassion. Focus. These traits define my life and drive my success as your Assemblymember. I’m focused on the long-term solutions we need to support businesses, build more housing, expedite services that help people off the streets and into permanent housing, address public safety, and improve the quality of life for us all. This reelection campaign is centered around you. Let's build a California for everyone!
